Keywords: impressions clicks ctr average position queries pages search analytics
What It Shows: All search queries that triggered your site's appearance in Google, plus clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position. Primary SEO performance dashboard.
How to Use: Filter by Query to find top keywords. Filter by Page to see which pages get most traffic. Compare date ranges (last 28 days vs previous period). Segment by Country, Device, Search Type.
Action: Find keywords ranking position 4-20 (quick win optimization targets). Find pages with high impressions but low CTR (fix meta title/description). Export data to Sheets for deeper analysis.

Keywords: url inspect crawl index check individual page status google cached version
What It Shows: Check the status of any individual URL — is it indexed? When was it last crawled? Is there a canonical issue? Shows Google's rendered version of the page.
How to Use: Enter any URL in the Search bar at top of GSC. See: Coverage status, last crawl date, canonical URL, mobile usability, rich results. Use 'Test Live URL' to get real-time crawl data.
Action: If page not indexed: check for noindex tags, canonical mismatches, or crawl errors. Use 'Request Indexing' after making updates to a priority page.

Keywords: index coverage status valid error excluded not indexed canonical crawl error
What It Shows: Shows which pages are indexed, excluded, or have errors. Broken into: Valid, Valid with warnings, Excluded, and Error statuses.
How to Use: Errors: Fix immediately (server errors, redirect errors, submitted URL not found). Excluded: Review if intentional (noindex, canonical redirect). Valid with warnings: usually low priority. Filter by type to see specific issues.
Action: Fix all Error pages first (they're blocking indexation). Review 'Excluded' for accidentally excluded important pages. Common issue: Canonical set to different URL (intentional or not).

Keywords: core web vitals CWV LCP FID CLS INP page experience ranking factor mobile desktop
What It Shows: Google's user experience metrics used as ranking signals. LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) < 2.5s. FID (First Input Delay) < 100ms → replaced by INP. CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) < 0.1.
How to Use: View by URL groups. Filter by Poor, Needs Improvement, Good. Click into a URL group to see specific pages affected. Compare Mobile vs Desktop (mobile is weighted more by Google).
Action: Fix LCP first (usually image optimization or removing render-blocking resources). Fix CLS by reserving space for images/ads. Use PageSpeed Insights for page-specific recommendations.

Keywords: sitemap xml submit status indexed coverage file sitemap.xml submitted
What It Shows: Submit and monitor your XML sitemap status. GSC shows if the sitemap was successfully fetched, how many URLs were submitted vs indexed.
How to Use: Submit sitemap: Sitemaps → Add a new sitemap → Enter sitemap URL (e.g. /sitemap.xml). Check status: 'Success' and verify submitted vs indexed count.
Action: If indexed count is much lower than submitted: investigate excluded URLs in Coverage. Resubmit sitemap after major site restructure. Use sitemap to track new content indexation speed.

Keywords: links external backlinks internal links anchor text top linking sites
What It Shows: Shows your top linked pages (external backlinks count), top linking sites, and top anchor text. Also shows internal linking structure.
How to Use: External Links: Find which pages attract the most backlinks (your 'link magnets'). Top Linking Sites: Identify your main referring domains. Internal Links: Find pages with few internal links (prioritize for internal linking).
Action: Find 'link magnets' (high-backlink pages) and build more similar content. Identify pages with 0 internal links (orphan pages) and link to them. Monitor for new linking sites.

Keywords: manual action penalty spam unnatural links thin content pure spam google penalty
What It Shows: Google's manual review team may apply manual actions (penalties) for policy violations. They appear here and cause ranking drops.
How to Use: Check regularly — any Manual Action requires immediate attention. Types: Unnatural links (to/from site), Thin content with little or no added value, Pure spam, User-generated spam.
Action: If Manual Action exists: Identify and fix the issue, submit a Reconsideration Request via GSC. Monitor for confirmation email (can take weeks). Do NOT ignore — traffic loss can be 80-100%.

Keywords: rich results structured data schema FAQ recipe review product eligibility status
What It Shows: Shows whether your pages with structured data are eligible for rich results (FAQ stars, recipe cards, review stars, etc.) in Google SERPs.
How to Use: See which rich result types are detected, errors, and valid pages. Click through to see specific URL issues. Match against your schema implementation.
Action: Fix schema errors immediately (invalid schema = no rich result eligibility). Expand valid rich results to more pages. Use 'Test Live URL' to check real-time schema status.

Keywords: search type web image video news google discover shopping filter performance
What It Shows: Filter Performance Report by search type: Web, Image, Video, News, Google Discover, Google Shopping. Each has different ranking signals.
How to Use: Switch between types in Performance Report filters. Discover: content must be engaging and timely. Image: optimize alt text and image file names. Video: use VideoObject schema.
Action: If Google Discover traffic exists — note which content performs (it signals content quality). Image search can be significant for e-commerce or visual content sites.
Frequency: Weekly (as part of overall performance review)
